Gathering evidence from the datasheet: the ordering table assigns one center wavelength per SKU (TQ2030-O55C-SO through TQ2030-O41C-SO). Shared technical data applies 1290–1325 nm, O-Band DWDM, 100GBASE/100GbE, 56.25 Gbaud, and 112.5 Gbps (with FEC). TQ2030-OXXC-SO is only described in the overview (50 Gbaud, 100 G Ethernet) and has no ordering row or single center wavelength, so it is omitted per the definitive-evidence rule.
